description: Create an Airflow DAG for fintech_app that builds the daily general-ledger snapshot only after the upstream core-banking system has closed the business day. The DAG should: (1) use a SqlSensor in reschedule mode that polls ledger_control.day_close for a row with close_date = {{ ds }} and status = 'CLOSED', (2) extract the day's journal entries into a staging table, (3) verify that total debits equal total credits for the day, (4) publish the snapshot table partition, (5) email the finance distribution list. The DAG runs daily at 01:00 UTC. The sensor should poll every 10 minutes for up to 6 hours. If debits and credits do not balance, the publish step must not run and the DAG must fail.
edge_cases: SqlSensor success criterion must check status = 'CLOSED'; a row with status = 'CLOSING' returns a truthy first cell if the query only selects the row
Journal extract must filter on posting_date = {{ ds }}, not on created_at, because late entries are created after midnight
Balance check must compare exact decimal sums, not floats
Sensor in poke mode would hold a worker slot for up to 6 hours; reschedule mode is required
common_failure_modes: FM6: Sensor query returns any row for the date, so the DAG proceeds while the day is still CLOSING
FM7: Balance check implemented as a logging task that never raises, so an unbalanced ledger is published
FM2: Filtering journal entries on created_at instead of posting_date drops late-posted entries
